theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (κ A τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → (∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / τ)) μ → |∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ| ≤ A * κ * τ * ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) ∂μ
